youtube.title: A song's 8-second vertical loop. Find the seam: funkbox checks it by machine and writes it down
youtube.description:
A song's 8-second loop. Find the seam.
funkbox rendered this 1080x1920 loop from a shader, played it here straight through the point where its last frame wraps to its first, and checked that seam by machine. New this week: the result is written into the loop's own JSON file (shown on screen, verbatim).
This Short rendered in under 60 seconds on a 4-core CPU with no GPU; all 8 on-screen strings matched the approved copy. No video model.
Free, open source, runs locally: https://github.com/IsraelWebDev/funkbox
Made with funkbox.
